stem: Imran reads a cricket scoreboard that shows overs as $9.4$.

options.text: $9.4$ overs means $9$ overs and $4$ balls in the next over.
$9.4$ overs means $9$ overs plus four-tenths of an over.
$9.4$ is an ordinary decimal because a point is printed between $9$ and $4$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: In overs notation the point separates completed overs from balls (out of 6), so it is not ordinary decimal place value.

teacher.key_rationale: Cricket overs use a point as a balls separator (max 5 after the point), not tenths of an over.
